# A leaf raft: a moving platform. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Leafy --base-color 0.416 0.745 0.188 --no-slot
material new Stalk --base-color 0.216 0.580 0.431 --no-slot
add mesh uv-sphere --segments 10 --rings 4 --radius 0.5 --name Leaf --location 0 0 -0.07
scale 1.72 0.9 0.14
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Leafy
active Leaf
mode edit
select vert where "pos.x > 0.6"
translate 0 0 0.04
mode object
add mesh cone --vertices 4 --radius1 0.1 --radius2 0 --depth 0.24 --name Tip --location 0.92 0 -0.02
set rotation 0 90 0
apply --rotation
apply --location
material assign Leafy
add mesh cylinder --vertices 5 --radius 0.045 --depth 0.5 --name Hang --location -0.6 0.1 -0.3
set rotation 0 30 0
apply --rotation
apply --location
material assign Stalk
select Leaf Tip Hang
active Leaf
join
rename Leaf Raft
select all
shade flat
export raft.glb
